question: Do (q_a, q_b) finite-diff omega-vectors from a single small-|C_t| anchor pair concentrate near the truth-omega direction?
hypothesis: Anchoring at a deep |C_t| constriction and filtering cross-epoch q_b by the |omega|-prior makes surviving omega-vectors concentrate near truth-omega-direction.
narrative_md: First proof-of-concept of the cloud-data anchor architecture on seed 89: anchor at the deepest constriction t_a=411 (|C_a|=44), all-pair finite-diff omega at dt=10, filter by |omega|-prior. Signal is real but weak -- loose +-25% prior gives 2.7% within 10deg of truth vs 1.5% baseline (1.79x); the closest-survivor pair implies omega 20.4deg off truth direction with |omega| +28%. Uses truth-omega direction + oracle +-0.5% bracket -- oracle-leak, N=1.
